item.tib: srid rgyal thugs kyi bsgrub thabs nag mo'i mthu bsgrub kyi bca' gzhi lag len las kyi mtha' bsgyur gcig rgyud man ngag u ya pa
item.coloph: de ltar nag mo'i mthu bsgrub man ngag bstan pa gcig rgyud las mi rung ngo / shin tu gsang / bka' rgya/ nan rgya/ zab rgya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ma 'da' sa ma ya/ bka' rgya snying gi thig le khyod la sbin gsungs nas gzha' ltar yal lo/ nag mo srid rgyal gyi snyan rgyud sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
